seo.title: Our Programs — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Isôoko runs five programs: Women Empowerment (MWU), Youth Empowerment (IZI), Sports & Wellness, Digital & Literacy, and Tûuza Mubyeyi childcare.

hero.title: Our Programs
hero.subtitle: Five pillars of inclusive community development

overview.title: What We Do
overview.subtitle: Integrated programs designed for lasting impact

womenEmpowerment.title: Women Empowerment Program
womenEmpowerment.subtitle: Mutima W'urugo (MWU)
womenEmpowerment.desc: Empowering vulnerable women with skills and resources to drive socio-economic change.
womenEmpowerment.intro: We believe that the rise of a Woman is the rise of a community. The MWU program is designed to empower vulnerable women in the community with skills and resources that help them find a voice and be the agent of socio-economic change.
offerings: Saving groups and access to finance

youthEmpowerment.title: Youth Empowerment Program
youthEmpowerment.subtitle: Imbaraga z' Isôoko (IZI)
youthEmpowerment.desc: Fostering youth leadership, skills, and sustainable livelihoods in Masoro.
youthEmpowerment.intro: The Masoro Sector, located in a mining area, relies heavily on the mining industry. Youth face limited access to education, mental health concerns, and difficulties securing stable employment. The IZI program addresses these challenges through a supportive learning environment that fosters youth leadership and sustainability.

sportsWellness.title: Sports and Wellness Services
sportsWellness.subtitle: Physical & Mental Wellness
sportsWellness.desc: A hub for wellness, sports, and mental health initiatives.
sportsWellness.intro: The Isôoko Community Center serves as a hub for wellness and community engagement through sports and mental health initiatives. Beneficiaries enjoy a wide range of physical and mental wellness activities designed to enhance resilience and promote well-being.
offerings: First aid and emergency preparedness training

digitalLiteracy.title: Digital & Literacy Services
digitalLiteracy.subtitle: Skills for the Digital Age
digitalLiteracy.desc: Essential learning opportunities in digital skills and literacy.
digitalLiteracy.intro: The Isôoko Community Center provides essential learning opportunities to empower individuals with digital skills and literacy programs, creating pathways for professional and personal growth.

tuuzaMubyeyi.title: Tûuza Mubyeyi Project
tuuzaMubyeyi.subtitle: Childcare for Mothers in Program
tuuzaMubyeyi.desc: Comprehensive childcare enabling mothers to focus on socio-economic transformation.
tuuzaMubyeyi.intro: The Tûuza Mubyeyi Project supports vulnerable mothers in our programs by providing comprehensive care for their children while they focus on their socio-economic transformation. Children receive high-quality educational and developmental activities in a safe, nurturing environment. Meanwhile, mothers pursue their small-scale projects, fostering economic stability and personal growth.
